tests.assertion: test('4915全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，两版魂印17招首轮同类型与免异分支，三招记录冲突显式回滚',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38432?Math.min(m.pp,pp+1):pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),before=structuredClone(s),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);assert.throws(()=>H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716),/Q-4915-002/);assert.deepEqual(s,before);}}});
